modules.title: manifest.json 怎样变成安装入口
Manifest 负责安装后的哪些信息

items.title: 它集中描述应用身份和启动方式
items.text: name 影响安装后的名称，icons 提供系统图标，start_url 指定启动地址，display 影响打开时更像独立应用还是普通标签页。页面要通过 link 关联正确文件。

items.title: 安装后结果才是验收证据
items.text: 修改文件后要重新安装，检查名称、图标、启动路径和窗口形态。浏览器能打开网页，只能证明页面可访问，不代表这些安装信息正确。

modules.title: 它不等于完整 PWA 或 Favicon
modules.text: {c:web-app-manifest} 描述 Web 应用的安装和启动信息；{c:favicon} 主要服务浏览器标签页和书签；离线缓存还需要其他运行机制。拥有 Manifest 不会自动保证离线可用。

lessonPractice.title: 网站安装后总是从错误路径打开，应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查 Manifest 的 start_url，并重新安装后验证启动地址
options.feedback: 对。安装后的默认启动地址由 Manifest 等安装配置决定，不能靠更换 Favicon 修复。

options.label: 更换 Favicon，因为浏览器会从它推断启动路径
options.feedback: Favicon 负责浏览器站点识别，不负责安装后的默认启动 URL。

options.label: 只添加 Service Worker，并假设启动地址会自动变正确
options.feedback: Service Worker 与缓存或离线行为有关，不能替代检查 Manifest 的 start_url。

en.title: An installed site always opens at the wrong path. What should you check first?

options.label: Check the Manifest start_url and verify the launch address after reinstalling
options.feedback: Correct. The default installed launch address comes from install configuration such as the Manifest, not from changing the Favicon.

options.label: Change the Favicon because the browser infers the launch path from it
options.feedback: A Favicon identifies a site in browser surfaces; it does not define the installed default URL.

options.label: Only add a Service Worker and assume the launch address will become correct
options.feedback: A Service Worker relates to caching or offline behavior and cannot replace checking the Manifest start_url.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查 manifest link 指向的 Web App Manifest，核对 name、icons、start_url 和 display。修正后删除并重新安装，再验证主屏幕名称、图标、启动地址和窗口形态；不要把可安装等同于离线可用。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the Web App Manifest referenced by manifest link and check name, icons, start_url, and display. After fixing it, remove and reinstall the app, then verify the Home Screen name, icon, launch URL, and window mode. Do not equate installability with offline support.

learning.assumes: You have seen a browser offer an install entry for a site or opened a manifest.json file.
learning.outcome: You can trace the installed name, icon, launch URL, and window mode back to Manifest fields and distinguish install configuration from offline capability.

modules.title: How manifest.json becomes an install entry
What the Manifest controls after installation

items.title: It describes identity and launch behavior
items.text: name affects the installed name, icons provide system artwork, start_url sets the launch address, and display influences whether it opens like an app or a normal tab. The page must link the intended file.

items.title: The installed result is the evidence
items.text: After editing the file, reinstall and check the name, icon, launch path, and window mode. A page opening in a browser proves only that it is reachable, not that install metadata is correct.

modules.title: It is not a complete PWA or a Favicon
modules.text: {c:web-app-manifest} describes Web app installation and launch information; a {c:favicon} mainly serves browser tabs and bookmarks; offline caching needs other runtime mechanisms. A Manifest alone does not guarantee offline support.

distinctions.label: Favicon
distinctions.text: {c:web-app-manifest} supplies app name, icon, and launch information for an install entry; a {c:favicon} supplies the site icon for browser tabs, bookmarks, and history.

distinctions.label: App Icon
distinctions.text: The {c:web-app-manifest} icons field points to artwork usable by installation; {c:app-icon} is the visual object as it appears in operating-system surfaces.
